test_title: PYST 25: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 30 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.

As far as possible, solid waste should be managed at the household level so that minimum waste is __delivered__ for management at the community level.
solution:
The correct answer is: **deposited**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The underlined word in the given sentence is **"delivered,"** which in this context means to take or pass something to a specific place or person. (पहुंचा दिया)
 
• **"Deposited"** means to put or set down in a specific place, especially for storage. (जमा करना).
